reason: Runs only when logind suspends the machine.
proof: logind's Suspend() returns only after it has started the suspend. The tests must not suspend the developer's machine, so they call it under their own block lock and check the refusal (test_now_without_an_instance_is_refused_by_logind). Since systemd 257 logind enforces block locks for every caller, the caller's own included, unless SD_LOGIND_SKIP_INHIBITORS is passed, which the app never does. There is no second logind to call instead: systemd-logind runs once per system as root and manages the real seats and sessions, so a test can't start one of its own on a private bus.

reason: Runs only when logind suspends the machine.
proof: Controller.sleep_now raises unless logind accepted Suspend(), and an accepted Suspend() suspends the machine. The tests take their own block lock first and check that `now` answers with logind's refusal (test_command_line_on_off_and_now, test_tray_menu_and_clicks). See cli.py 120-121.

reason: A handler that raises anything but BackendError.
proof: The only handler is Ui.handle, which calls commands.answer. That catches BackendError from the Controller, and backend._call turns every D-Bus error reply into BackendError; the one reply it reads, Inhibit's (o), always holds the object path (xdg-desktop-portal answers through GDBus, which checks replies against the out signature). Its other calls (Ui.show_window, describe) are Qt and string calls that don't raise, and nothing a client sends gets past the COMMANDS check on line 130 to anything else. The catch stays so that a future bug answers with an error instead of PyQt aborting the process.
